description: The working tree has an uncommitted change to textstats/counts.py. A one-line stop before any change, so the task's commit would hold only its own work.

must_match.pattern: ^Uncommitted changes in textstats/counts\.py\. Commit or stash them, then run implement-task again\.\s*\Z
must_match.why: the exact stop line names the changed file and is the last line

must_not_match.why: the user's change is left alone
